text:
It's a pediatrics clinic across the street from Hangdong Kad Farang.
It opens at 9 a.m. on Saturdays and 5 p.m. on other days.
The female pediatrician who is good at English is very kind and good at medical treatment.
The nurses are also very kind and attentive. Maybe it's because the business hours are short, but there are many children's patients every time I go.
You can take a flu test and get a prescription for Tamiflu.
I come here for mild symptoms such as children's colds, which are cheaper and closer than general hospitals and have a shorter waiting time.

There are a lot of toys and it looks neat overall, but the floor is often messy because there are many customers.
I don't want to wear slippers because they're so messy. It would be better if you change the slippers or pay more attention to cleaning the floor.
